about: Hanover is a rural municipality in southeastern Manitoba surrounding the City of Steinbach—not the Town of Hanover in Ontario. Villages such as Grunthal and Blumenort sit among Mennonite farm country along Highways 12 and 52. The RM provides rural services while Steinbach remains a separate urban municipality. About 17,000 people live in Hanover RM.
